amazon_sagemaker_endpoint_status_changed.description: Runs each time an endpoint status changes in Amazon SageMaker. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields EndpointName, EndpointArn, CreationTime, LastModifiedTime, EndpointStatus
